text.arabic_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector linking the prior knowledge claim to a fresh ownership declaration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes from the previous knowledge statement into a new ownership declaration. The connector keeps 53:30 and 53:31 joined, while the following clause has its own complete predicate-subject frame.

topics.headline: resumptive opening links knowledge to ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not restart cold; the opening connector carries the previous knowledge scene into a new jurisdiction claim.
topics.reason: The particle begins a complete ownership clause while preserving discourse continuity with 53:30.

words.gloss_range: possessive preposition fused into the divine-name phrase; distinct from the later purpose lām
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the possessive lām in the opening ownership phrase. It puts possession before the totality that follows, and its function remains distinct from the later purpose lām at word 11.

topics.headline: possessive lām front-loads ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ownership before the owned domains are named, so possession frames the whole cosmic list from the start.
topics.reason: Local grammar treats the first lām as possession governing the divine name in a fronted predicate.

topics.headline: same particle form, different function later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated lām-shape does two jobs: ownership here and purpose at word 11.
topics.reason: The two lām tokens occupy different syntactic frames, so their formal echo does not collapse their functions.

words.gloss_range: fronted divine possessor in a verbless ownership predicate, anchoring cosmic jurisdiction and later recompense agency
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field associated with worship, dependence, refuge, and awe; locally the proper name anchors the owner and implied recompensing agent
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) names the divine owner inside a fronted verbless predicate, so ownership is heard as the stable frame for all that follows. The name also widens the prior address of 53:30 into public cosmic jurisdiction, while same-surah echoes of possession and heavenly authority (53:25; 53:26) keep the authority thread active. Its root pressure can add worship, dependence, and awe, but the local word remains the proper divine name in a possessive construction.

topics.headline: proper name anchors fronted ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine ownership is stated as a standing frame before recompense begins, not as a later inference.
topics.reason: The proper divine name is governed by the possessive lām and functions in the fronted predicate before the delayed totality subject.

topics.headline: divine-name field adds dependence and awe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the owner named by the proper divine name as the focus of worship, dependence, and awe, while the local grammar keeps this as a proper-name occurrence.
topics.reason: The supplied root and derivational pressure can color the divine name, but it does not replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: your Lord becomes universal divine ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a register shift from the addressed Lord of 53:30 to a public universal ownership claim in 53:31.
topics.reason: Boundary rows show the same divine referent continuing while the naming frame widens.

topics.headline: same-surah authority thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this ownership claim as part of the surah-local divine authority thread, including final/first possession (53:25) and heavenly intercession control (53:26).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah links where the divine name, heavens, authority, and ownership recur.

topics.headline: fused possessive opening sounds compact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ownership marker and divine name compressed into one dense opening unit.
topics.reason: The surface form binds the possessive lām to the divine-name onset.

words.gloss_range: headless relative subject meaning whatever is in the heavenly domain
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) works as a headless relative subject after the fronted ownership phrase. It opens the scope to whatever is in the heavens rather than to a named item or narrow class.

topics.headline: whatever-in-heavens subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership covers whatever is in the heavenly domain, not only the domain label itself.
topics.reason: The headless relative is the delayed subject and is completed by the following locative phrase.

words.gloss_range: locative containment marker completing the first relative phrase
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies the first containment relation. It makes the phrase mean the contents within the heavenly domain, allowing the totality claim to reach what the domain holds.

topics.headline: first containment phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording claims ownership of contents within the heavens, not merely of a named place.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the heavenly complement and supplies the relative clause for the first mā.

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper cosmic domain, internally multiple and paired with the singular earth as totality
words.root_gloss_range: height, upperness, sky/heaven, and naming/elevation associations; locally selected as the plural upper cosmic domain paired with earth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:as-samāwāti}}) is the recognized plural upper domain: layered heavens rather than a single indefinite sky. Its height-root pressure makes the upper pole feel elevated, while the local construction keeps the selected sense as the plural cosmic domain. Paired with earth, it begins the familiar heavens-earth merism, and the same domain recalls the intercession-control scene of 53:26.

topics.headline: definite plural upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the upper realm is presented as recognized and internally multiple before it is paired with earth.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, feminine plural, genitive under the locative phrase, and contrasts with singular earth.

topics.headline: height and upper-surface pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the owned upper domain as elevated and layered, while local usage selects the heavens rather than every s-m-w branch.
topics.reason: Root evidence adds height and upperness pressure, but local grammar selects the plural cosmic-domain noun.

topics.headline: upper pole of totality formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the heavens-earth pair as a total-domain formula: the upper pole begins a continuum of ownership.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and local parallelism support the merism with word 10.

topics.headline: heavenly authority returns from intercession scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavenly domain constrained in intercession language (53:26) now appears inside the ownership frame.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows give the concrete 53:26 heavenly authority echo.

topics.headline: expanded and fused recitation shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the upper-domain word arrive as a long, definite recitational unit.
topics.reason: The rows point to long vowels and article assimilation in the local surface.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector extending the same ownership predicate to the second domain phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second domain phrase with the first. It extends the same ownership predicate from the upper domain to the lower without making earth a loose add-on.

topics.headline: connector adds the lower domain phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is added as a full parallel domain phrase, not as a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second mā-fī phrase with the first.

words.gloss_range: second headless relative preserving distributive totality over the earth-domain contents
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) repeats the headless relative pattern for the earth side. The wording builds two panels, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, instead of compressing totality into one abstract noun.

topics.headline: repeated whatever makes earth distributive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a second complete whatever-is-in panel, so terrestrial contents receive their own explicit scope.
topics.reason: The second headless relative repeats the first subject architecture under the same ownership predicate.

words.gloss_range: second locative containment marker, giving the lower domain the same syntactic frame as the upper
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) repeats the containment marker for the lower domain. That repetition gives earth the same syntactic dignity as the heavens in the ownership frame.

topics.headline: repeated containment equalizes earth phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lower domain is framed with the same inside-ness as the upper domain.
topics.reason: The repeated locative preposition governs earth and preserves syntactic symmetry.

words.gloss_range: definite singular terrestrial domain, the lower pole that completes the totality formula
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, land, lower part, and terrestrial domain; locally selected as the singular lower pole of the heavens-earth totality
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) closes the cosmic pair as the definite singular lower domain. Its ground-root pressure makes the claim descend from layered heavens to the substrate underfoot, while the local merism selects earth as the lower pole of totality. The same word also points forward to 53:32, where earth becomes the human-origin ground.

topics.headline: recognized singular lower domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth lands as one recognized lower realm against the multiple heavens.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, singular, and genitive under the second locative phrase.

topics.headline: ground and lower-part pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ownership claim descend to the ground underfoot, while local pairing selects the terrestrial domain sense.
topics.reason: The root field supports ground and lower-part pressure but the heavens-earth pairing selects cosmic lower pole.

topics.headline: earth completes totality formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the lower pole completing the heavens-earth merism before recompense begins.
topics.reason: Local parallelism and co-occurrence evidence make the paired domains a totality formula.

topics.headline: owned earth anticipates origin ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owned earth of 53:31 is picked up immediately in 53:32 as the ground tied to human origin.
topics.reason: The rows give a concrete forward same-surah bridge to 53:32.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām governing the recompense clause, with consequence/result pressure kept secondary
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) pivots the completed ownership claim into recompense. The subjunctive verb that follows favors purpose, while the consequence shade remains useful: divine ownership is shown as both the stated aim and inevitable setting of justice.

topics.headline: purpose lām pivots ownership into recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the ownership declaration matters: it turns into a purpose frame for recompense.
topics.reason: The lām governs subjunctive recompense and scopes over both recompense branches.

topics.headline: purpose with consequence pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear recompense as both stated aim and inevitable outcome, while the local subjunctive favors purpose.
topics.reason: The ambiguity is productive, but grammar selects the purpose reading most strongly.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form I recompense verb: divine requital of the negative class by the measure of deeds
words.root_gloss_range: requital, recompense, rendering back, reward, and punishment; local valence is selected by recipients and measure phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant of the recompense verb with first-person plural divine voice

words.prose: {{ar:يَجْزِىَ}} ({{tr:yajziya}}) is the first recompense verb under that purpose lām. Its subject is implicit but returns to the divine owner; its object is the evildoer class, and the following bāʾ phrase supplies the deed-measure. The j-z-y root is value-neutral recompense, so the negative valence comes from the recipients and measure. The accepted variant {{ar:لِنَجْزِيَ}} ({{tr:li-najziya}}) can make the divine voice direct, but the canonical surface keeps third-person narration while preserving the same agent.

topics.headline: implied divine agent with recipients and measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact accounting structure: God is implied as agent, the evildoers are recipients, and their deeds are the measure.
topics.reason: Verb morphology, object attachment, and the bāʾ phrase define the argument frame.

topics.headline: neutral recompense root becomes negative by context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb itself is neutral recompense; the negative branch comes from the recipient class and deed-measure.
topics.reason: The j-z-y field covers reward and punishment, and local complements select negative requital.

topics.headline: Form I direct requital preserves hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recompense as a direct divine act, not a reciprocal exchange between peers.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I rather than reciprocal Form III.

topics.headline: accepted variant shifts discourse person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register that the variant {{ar:لِنَجْزِيَ}} ({{tr:li-najziya}}) makes divine agency more direct, while the canonical surface keeps third-person narration.
topics.reason: The accepted variant changes person without changing agent or purpose structure.

topics.headline: recompense verb binds both moral branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one recompense mechanism span both branches before the complements separate proportional evil from superlative good.
topics.reason: Rows connect j-z-y with deed accounting, repeated word 19, and later/passive recompense in 53:41.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun making the first recipient class action-defined
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the first recipient group an action-defined class. It does not name a tribe or fixed status; the following predicate supplies the identity. Its form also anticipates the matching relative pronoun in the good branch.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines first recipient class by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first group is not named by tribe or status; grammar defines them by the action that follows.
topics.reason: The plural relative pronoun is the object of the recompense verb and is completed by its relative predicate.

topics.headline: first relative shell anticipates second class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two moral classes are built in matching relative-pronoun shells before their predicates diverge.
topics.reason: Word 13 anticipates the identical class marker at word 20.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural bad-doing, object left open so the negative class is defined by completed evil action generally
words.root_gloss_range: evil, badness, ugliness, harm, and bad consequence; locally a Form IV completed action defining the negative class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: matched positive Form IV plural verb used as the lexical contrast

words.prose: {{ar:أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟}} ({{tr:asāʾū}}) completes the first class with perfect plural bad-doing. The missing object keeps the harm open and class-defining, while the s-w-ʾ field joins evil, ugliness, and harm. Its Form IV shape presents badness as caused action, and its contrast with {{ar:أَحْسَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:aḥsanū}}) makes the moral binary lexical before the reward terms appear.

topics.headline: completed bad action without named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative class is defined by completed evil action in general, not by one listed offense.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect plural verb has no explicit object, so the action remains class-defining and open.

topics.headline: evil and ugliness form the negative field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the negative verb as moral evil with ugliness and harm in its root field.
topics.reason: The supplied s-w-ʾ semantics support negative moral-aesthetic valence locally.

topics.headline: bad-doing answers good-doing as lexical opposite
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moral binary is lexical before it is thematic: s-w-ʾ stands opposite h-s-n in matched Form IV plural verbs.
topics.reason: The local branch sets word 14 against word 21 with matching form and opposite roots.

topics.headline: Form IV agency with audible rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices badness as caused action, and the stretched hamza break makes that negative verb sound interrupted.
topics.reason: Rows support Form IV causative force and the local madd-hamza sound shape.

topics.headline: evil branch is measured rather than root-echoed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the evil branch moves to what they did instead of producing a same-root reward noun.
topics.reason: The negative root links to deed accounting, while only the good branch receives a same-root reward noun.

words.gloss_range: bāʾ of basis or measure, tying negative recompense to what was done
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the basis of recompense in the negative branch. It turns the following deed clause into a proportional standard: the return is by what they themselves did.

topics.headline: bāʾ turns deeds into proportional measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first recompense branch is tied to the agents own deeds as its standard.
topics.reason: The bāʾ governs the mā-clause and attaches it as the measure/basis of recompense.

words.gloss_range: headless relative or maṣdar-like marker compressing the deed measure into what they did/their doing
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) compresses the deed basis into a compact relative or maṣdar-like unit. Whether heard as what they did or their doing, it keeps the measure open without listing each deed.

topics.headline: mā compresses what they did
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the measure remains open enough to include the whole deed inventory without listing it.
topics.reason: Relative and maṣdar-like readings both support the same deed-output basis.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural work/deed verb closing the proportional measure phrase
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, practicing, producing action, and deed-output; locally the completed deeds used as recompense measure
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) closes the measure phrase with completed plural action. The ʿ-m-l field makes the measure feel like produced deed-output or accumulated work, and the open phrase contrasts sharply with the later definite superlative reward.

topics.headline: completed work supplies the measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is measured by completed deed-output, not by an abstract label alone.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb closes the mā-clause and leaves the object field open through mā.

topics.headline: work-root frames accumulated action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the deeds as produced work or accumulated action, while local grammar keeps the phrase as the measure clause.
topics.reason: The ʿ-m-l field supports purposeful work/deed-output; no broader branch is imported beyond the local verb.

topics.headline: open deed measure contrasts superlative reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the asymmetry: evil is repaid by what was worked, while the good branch ends with the best.
topics.reason: Local bāʾ complements contrast open deed measure with definite superlative reward.

topics.headline: plural perfect endings bind human actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the three human-action verbs held in one accountable plural rhythm.
topics.reason: The repeated perfect plural endings link bad-doing, deed-work, and good-doing.

words.gloss_range: connector opening the parallel positive recompense branch under the same purpose frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the second recompense branch after the first has closed. It balances the good-doer clause with the evildoer clause under the same purpose frame, while reprising the ayah's connector pattern at a new moral divide.

topics.headline: waw opens parallel positive branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the good-doer clause begins as a balanced second branch under the same purpose frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the second verb after the first branch is complete.

topics.headline: connector pattern marks major transitions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same connector used at boundary, domain, and moral-branch transitions.
topics.reason: The row tracks repeated connector function across the ayah.

words.gloss_range: repeated subjunctive recompense verb: same divine mechanism now oriented to good-doers and superlative reward
words.root_gloss_range: requital, recompense, rendering back, reward, and punishment; locally the repeated verb turns positive through good-doer recipients and superlative reward content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant of the second recompense verb with first-person plural divine voice
definite superlative reward content in the positive branch

words.prose: {{ar:يَجْزِىَ}} ({{tr:yajziya}}) repeats the recompense verb for the positive branch. The same divine agent and purpose scope continue, but the complement changes: good-doers receive {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَى}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}), so equivalent-return language is stretched toward superlative gift. The variant {{ar:وَنَجْزِيَ}} ({{tr:wa-najziya}}) can make the same divine agency speak directly, while the repeated canonical verb binds punishment and reward into one mechanism.

topics.headline: second verb remains under same divine purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward branch does not start a new system; the same implied divine agent and purpose scope continue.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under the earlier lām and repeats the implied divine subject.

topics.headline: same recompense frame takes superlative content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive branch stretch the accounting verb by giving it the best as its content.
topics.reason: The verb takes good-doers as recipients and the definite superlative as bāʾ complement.

topics.headline: direct Form I with variant divine voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices direct divine requital, while the variant {{ar:وَنَجْزِيَ}} ({{tr:wa-najziya}}) can make the same agency speak in first-person plural.
topics.reason: Form I preserves non-reciprocal reward, and the accepted variant changes discourse person without replacing the canonical surface.

topics.headline: j-z-y joins h-s-n reward diction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the positive branch enter a recognized excellence-and-reward formula, with concrete links to 10:26 and 55:60.
topics.reason: Rows connect j-z-y with h-s-n forms and supplied cross-references 10:26 and 55:60.

topics.headline: repeated verb binds punishment and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears punishment and reward share one verbal mechanism before their complements diverge.
topics.reason: The repeated j-z-y verb echoes word 12 and contrasts later passive recompense in 53:41.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun making the second recipient class action-defined in symmetry with word 13
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) repeats the same plural relative shell as word 13. The positive class is formally parallel to the negative class, and only the following predicate changes the moral value.

topics.headline: second relative pronoun defines good-doer class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rewarded class is defined by the good action that follows, not by a prior social label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the object of the second recompense verb and is completed by the good-doing predicate.

topics.headline: identical relative form balances classes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices formal equality between the two human classes before the predicates create moral contrast.
topics.reason: The exact relative-pronoun form repeats word 13 and completes the class pairing.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural good-doing, active production of goodness/excellence without a restricted object
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, beauty, excellence, improvement, and producing what is good; locally Form IV completed action defines the positive class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root definite superlative reward noun closing the positive branch

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْسَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:aḥsanū}}) defines the second class by completed good-doing without naming a restricted object. The h-s-n field joins goodness, beauty, excellence, and improvement, and Form IV makes that goodness actively produced. Because the same root returns in {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَى}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}), the good branch sounds generative in a way the evil branch does not, with wider excellence-reward echoes at 10:26 and 55:60.

topics.headline: completed good action without named object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that goodness is enacted broadly, not confined to one stated object or field.
topics.reason: The perfect plural Form IV verb is tied to the relative class and has no explicit object.

topics.headline: h-s-n joins moral goodness and beauty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels doing good as producing excellence and beauty, not merely satisfying a neutral rule.
topics.reason: The h-s-n field unites goodness, beauty, excellence, and improvement in the local positive branch.

topics.headline: Form IV makes goodness produced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agents bring about goodness rather than merely possess a good state.
topics.reason: The local form is Form IV, not Form I stative goodness.

topics.headline: good-doing completes the moral opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second branch answer bad-doing with a matched but value-opposite action form.
topics.reason: The positive verb contrasts word 14 and participates in the repeated perfect plural action pattern.

topics.headline: good deed generates same-root reward word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that only the good branch grows into a same-root reward, making goodness sound generative.
topics.reason: The h-s-n verb is followed by the h-s-n reward noun, unlike the negative branch.

topics.headline: excellence reward formula links 10:26 and 55:60
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the local verb-reward pair as part of a wider excellence-return formula (10:26; 55:60).
topics.reason: Rows supply concrete references where h-s-n action and reward language meet.

words.gloss_range: bāʾ governing the positive reward content, parallel to word 15 but no longer deed-measure
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs the positive reward content. It formally parallels the earlier bāʾ, but its object is not a deed-measure; it is the definite superlative, so the grammar itself carries the asymmetry between proportional repayment and surpassing reward.

topics.headline: bāʾ governs the superlative reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second bāʾ no longer measures deeds; it introduces the reward content itself.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the definite superlative and attaches to the second recompense verb.

topics.headline: same bāʾ frame, different object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the theological asymmetry in grammar: the first bāʾ takes an open deed clause, the second takes the best.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition creates formal parallelism while its complements create outcome asymmetry.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine elative, the best/most beautiful outcome functioning as reward content and ayah closure
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, beauty, excellence, and the finest/best outcome; locally a definite feminine elative functioning as reward content and final closure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root Form IV good-doing verb that the reward echoes

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَى}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}) is the ayah's final landing: a definite feminine elative functioning as the reward content, the best or most beautiful outcome without an explicit noun to limit it. It echoes {{ar:أَحْسَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:aḥsanū}}) through the h-s-n root, joins wider reward diction at 10:26 and 55:60, and closes the ayah with a long superlative sound after the opening claim of divine ownership.

topics.headline: definite elative carries the best outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is not merely a good thing but the known best, left open enough to exceed specification.
topics.reason: The feminine elative functions substantively as reward content without an explicit following noun.

topics.headline: same h-s-n field carries deed into reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward grow from the same goodness-beauty root as the deed, so the outcome is lexically continuous with good action.
topics.reason: The h-s-n root recurs from word 21 into the reward noun.

topics.headline: final superlative exceeds deed-measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close on surplus reward rather than on proportional deed accounting.
topics.reason: The final bāʾ phrase contrasts with the negative branch and occupies the closing word.

topics.headline: recognized reward keyword links 10:26 and 55:60
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final word as part of wider reward diction, including the finest outcome with more in 10:26 and excellence answered by excellence in 55:60.
topics.reason: Rows supply concrete cross-references 10:26 and 55:60.

topics.headline: long final sound frames ownership to reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the definite superlative linger as the final sound, closing the frame that opened with divine ownership.
topics.reason: Rows connect the maqṣūra ending, fawāṣil cadence, and ownership-to-reward frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ownership frame at words 1-7 and the repeated recompense verbs at words 8 and 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worshipped owner encloses both the upper covering and its lower counterpart, while matched requital and intentional work connect that total jurisdiction to what agents deliberately do.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one is the claimant, turning possession into moral jurisdiction.
The overhead sky or cover supplies the upper reach of the owned field.
The lower ground opposite the sky closes the field from below.
Requital matching an act makes the two repeated verbs the operative return mechanism.
Intentional doing supplies the agent-produced input that requital answers.

changed_reading.before: God owns creation and separately rewards or punishes people.
changed_reading.after: The total upper-lower domain is a single jurisdiction in which intentional acts remain answerable and are returned to their agents as fitting counterparts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between words 10-12 and the doubled حسن at words 15-16.
baseline_models.mechanism: The bad pole is tied to what was worked, but the good pole repeats goodness in both agent and outcome; because beneficent حسن can exceed bare justice, the verse permits bounded requital for harm and generative surplus for beautiful action.

activation_trace.role: Badness and ugliness identify the negative quality produced by the agents.
Intentional work bounds the negative return to enacted conduct.
Act-matching requital supplies the proportional baseline against which the positive excess is visible.
Goodness opposed to ugliness links the good-doer and the best outcome across the doubled root.
Beneficent or skillful action, including going beyond justice, opens a surplus rather than a merely symmetric credit.

changed_reading.before: Bad and good deeds occupy two symmetric columns in a reward ledger.
changed_reading.after: Harm is answered by enacted work, while beneficent beauty can propagate from beautiful action into the best or more-than-equivalent outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from divine ownership through يجزي to عملوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Within the divine estate, recompense can collect a due or discharge an obligation, while work can be an assigned charge, a wage-bearing service, or a transaction; moral consequence therefore also reads as the closing of accounts for commissioned agency.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped owner supplies the authority under which charges and accounts exist.
Standing in, sufficing, or settling a due makes recompense an obligation-closing operation.
Debt collection sharpens the image of consequences becoming due and being fully pursued.
An assigned official charge casts agency as commissioned responsibility.
Pay for work makes the resulting return legible as earned settlement.
Interpersonal transaction makes deeds relational entries rather than isolated inner states.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an externally imposed verdict on moral labels.
changed_reading.after: Agents exercise a charge within an owned estate, their dealings create dues, and recompense closes the resulting obligations and wages.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The heavens-earth pair, عملوا, and the non-dominant cutting/harvest mapping carried by the two يجزي occurrences.
baseline_models.mechanism: An overhead rain-bearing cover and fertile ground form a growth system; intentional work cultivates it, and the split ج ز ي inventory contributes readiness for cutting or harvest, allowing outcome to be the ripened material form of action.

activation_trace.role: The upper cover includes cloud and rain, supplying the descending condition of growth.
Soft fertile ground receives and materializes what is cultivated.
Intentional work functions as cultivation rather than a detached score.
Readiness for shearing or harvest supplies a ripening threshold for consequence.
Skillful beneficent action functions as good cultivation whose yield can exceed bare equivalence.

changed_reading.before: A tribunal assigns an unrelated result after an act is finished.
changed_reading.after: Acts are cultivated in the owned heavens-earth system until they ripen into harvest, with الحسنى as the best yield; this remains a material analogy, not a replacement etymology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement exposes human allocation, naming, authority, mediation, and conjecture as rival outcome-making systems. The focus ownership clause then reclaims not only property but the right to classify agents, assign shares, authorize relations, and determine consequences from knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a share frames the skewed division as a rival allocation of value.
A name as raised designation shows human labels trying to stabilize invented ranks.
Compelling proof is explicitly absent, removing the warrant for those labels.
An intercessor joining another supplies the attempted relational route around direct assignment.
Sufficiency or availing is negated, so mediation cannot independently alter the account.
Doubt and supposition expose the weak epistemic basis of the rival system.
Disclosure to the knower contrasts divine discrimination with conjectural classification.
The worshipped owner becomes the exclusive source of valid classification and allotment.
Matched requital replaces invented shares with outcomes anchored in acts.

structural_cues: The sequence 53:21-30 moves from a biased division to invented names, absent authority, dependent intercession, conjecture, and finally the contrast between limited and divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed allocation, labeling, authorization, mediation, and knowledge claims; I infer that 53:31 transfers jurisdiction over all five to the owner. A live narrower alternative is that the sequence only rejects idols and leaves the recompense clause juridically generic.

changed_reading.before: The verse states universal ownership before announcing judgment.
changed_reading.after: Universal ownership invalidates counterfeit systems that name moral ranks, distribute shares, or broker outcomes; bad and good are divinely known action-relations, not self-issued identities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The standing-in branch of recompense is constrained from both sides: an intercessor may join another only dependently, while a heavy moral load is not transferred. This permits authorized accompaniment without replacement of the deed-bearer.

activation_trace.role: Standing in or discharging a due raises the possibility of substitution inside recompense.
The intercessor joins rather than erases the other party, supplying a relational but dependent mechanism.
Negated sufficiency blocks the joined party from independently settling the account.
The heavy load remains non-transferable, preserving personal ownership of culpability.

structural_cues: 53:26 conditions intercession on permission and approval, whereas 53:38 denies transfer of one bearer's burden to another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependent joining, inability to suffice, and non-transferable load; I infer a distinction between accompaniment and replacement. The live alternative is strict non-substitution, treating the standing-in branch as inactive here.

changed_reading.before: Each agent faces an entirely atomized settlement with no relational participation.
changed_reading.after: The deed and its burden stay personal, yet authorized relational accompaniment can coexist with recompense without becoming an independent substitute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation breaks a flat bad/good binary into scale, proximity, formation, protection, and mercy. The owner evaluates trajectories of avoidance and protection while remembering created development, and forbids agents from certifying their own purity.

activation_trace.role: Moral badness supplies the apparently categorical negative pole that context differentiates.
Beneficent action supplies a practiced positive orientation rather than a self-awarded status.
Approaching a small sin inserts degree and incidental proximity inside the negative field.
Expanded license and removal of hardship prevent the account from becoming mechanically narrow.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effect introduces consequence-interruption.
Bringing a being into existence makes developmental origin part of the evaluator's knowledge.
Purity and soundness become precisely what agents may not certify for themselves.
Placing oneself in protection recasts goodness as maintained orientation and practice.

structural_cues: 53:32 immediately names avoidance of major enormities, excepts minor approach, expands forgiveness, recalls formation from earth and embryos, prohibits self-purification, and reserves knowledge of protective orientation to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scale, minor proximity, covering mercy, formation, anti-self-certification, and protection; I infer calibrated evaluation of a lived trajectory. A live alternative treats these only as a list of legal exceptions around an otherwise binary classification.

changed_reading.before: Those who did bad and those who did good are two fixed, self-evident populations.
changed_reading.after: The contrast names trajectories known by their creator: major patterns are avoided, minor proximity can be covered, goodness is protective practice, and neither class may be self-certified.

context_deltas.mechanism: Burden cannot migrate, purposeful effort is the person's own acquisition, that effort becomes visible, and recompense reaches completion without deficit. The focus link between عمل and جزاء becomes a personal causal chain rather than a group label.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing anchors the chain in conduct attributable to its agent.
A heavy load that one bearer cannot carry for another makes liability non-transferable.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end identifies the agent's own directed effort.
Work and acquisition make the effort an inspectable yield that will be shown.
Act-matching recompense explicitly reconnects the shown effort to its return.
Full completion without deficiency closes the chain at its exact due.

structural_cues: 53:38-41 forms a tight sequence: no transferred burden, only one's striving, striving made visible, then the fullest recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transfer, owned striving, visibility, and completion; I infer that disclosure mediates between action and settlement. A live alternative reads the sequence as four independent legal propositions rather than one causal pipeline.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a broad sorting of bad and good collectives.
changed_reading.after: Each person's directed effort remains personally borne, becomes visible, and is then brought to a complete matching settlement without deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus outcome mechanism sits inside a later chain of divine endpoints and paired transformations: limit, death/life, measured creation, pairing, and renewed emergence. Recompense can therefore be read as one phase of an owned creation-to-return process, not merely an external ledger.

activation_trace.role: The overhead created field supplies the cosmic scale within which transformations occur.
Matched return is the focus transformation whose place in the larger causal chain is being tested.
The endpoint at which a thing terminates supplies a telos for the return.
Departure of life and power supplies one pole of divine transformation.
Earth becoming alive through rain and growth supplies the reverse pole and reconnects the chain to the focus earth.
Measuring and proportioning a created thing makes paired outcomes part of ordered formation.
Making one thing a counterpart to another supplies the polarity mechanism.
Bringing forth anew carries the chain beyond present life into another emergence.

structural_cues: 53:42-48 repeatedly attributes endpoints and opposite-producing verbs to the same divine subject, culminating in another emergence and sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a common agent and a sequence of endpoint, polarity, formation, and renewed emergence; I infer that recompense belongs to that transformation continuum. The juridical account remains fully live as an alternative rather than being absorbed into this ontological model.

changed_reading.before: Judgment is an administrative event appended to an otherwise separate creation.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is also a terminal transformation within the same measured power that generates paired states, ends present life, and brings forth another emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exploratory harvest baseline gains a destructive realization: limit-crossing cultivation reaches its cutting point, falls into annihilation, leaves no remainder, is overturned, and is comprehensively covered. The good pole remains a different yield rather than the mirror image of ruin.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground provides the material field in which an enacted pattern can grow.
Readiness for cutting or harvest turns consequence into a reached maturation point.
Falling into annihilation supplies the destructive harvest outcome.
The denied remainder makes the cutting total rather than selective.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the pattern that ripens toward ruin.
Turning a thing away from its orientation materializes reversal of the cultivated order.
A covering that encompasses the whole supplies the terminal engulfing action.

structural_cues: 53:50-54 compresses earlier peoples into a progression of annihilation, no remainder, excessive wrongdoing, overturning, and total covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile ground, harvest readiness, limit crossing, annihilation, remainder, reversal, and covering; I infer a cultivation-to-cutting arrow. The live alternative is straightforward historical punishment with no agricultural resonance.

changed_reading.before: The harvest branch was an isolated lexical-material possibility in the focus.
changed_reading.after: The later destruction sequence lets bad work look like a pattern grown to a cutting threshold and removed without remainder, while الحسنى remains the coexisting best-yield trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final command converts the focus's universal ownership and moral return into bodily alignment: the one who owns high and low is answered by lowering the body and entering obedient worship. Jurisdiction therefore aims at transformed posture, not only a future verdict.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped owner supplies the addressee of the final embodied response.
Rising and elevation establish the high pole that bodily lowering reverses.
Lower ground supplies the destination toward which the body aligns.
Humbling and lowering turn recognition of ownership into enacted submission.
Bowing the head gives the vertical reversal a concrete bodily mechanism.
Obedient worship makes the posture a sustained relation rather than a single gesture.

structural_cues: The surah closes at 53:62 with two coordinated imperatives directed to God: prostrate and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the high-low ownership axis and final lowering/worship commands; I infer that judgment's intended effect begins as present bodily alignment. The live alternative confines the command to liturgical closure without rereading 53:31.

changed_reading.before: Universal ownership and recompense are propositions about divine status and future outcome.
changed_reading.after: The same claim reorganizes present posture: what is high and low belongs to God, so the agent answers by lowering the body and practicing obedient worship now.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م target carried by the focus root س م و and joins it to later uncovering; it remains anchored in السماوات, intentional work, recompense, nearness, and disclosure. Render it only as an exploratory visible-mark resonance, never as the lexical meaning of السماوات or as proof that judgment is merely automatic.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split س م و inventory at word 4, عملوا at word 12, and the recompense frame.

activation_trace.role: A condition read from visible signs supplies the possibility that action leaves a discernible moral trace.
Intentional action supplies what could inscribe the trace rather than receiving an arbitrary label.
Matched return makes recognition of the trace consequential.
Near approach turns the latent trace toward imminent manifestation.
Lifting a cover supplies disclosure rather than fabrication of the final condition.

changed_reading.before: A verdict arrives from outside and assigns a previously absent moral status.
changed_reading.after: Intentional deeds may already bear readable traces, with the approaching event uncovering and matching what has become inscribed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the idiomatic حسن branch of utmost effort and connects it to repeated endpoint roots; it remains anchored in the doubled حسن of the focus and in the surrounding sequence of attained extent, full completion, and final limit. Render it as a resonance in which goodness tends toward consummation, not as a replacement gloss for أحسنوا or الحسنى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled حسن at words 15-16, especially its utmost-effort branch.

activation_trace.role: Utmost effort or limit lets the repeated goodness terms describe action carried toward excellent completion.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the nearby contrast of a stunted versus excellent attained limit.
Completion without deficiency gives the good trajectory a consummating rather than merely compensating end.
The final limit gathers effort and completed recompense into a shared endpoint pattern.

changed_reading.before: Those who do good receive a conventionally named good reward.
changed_reading.after: Good action can be heard as effort carried toward its excellent limit, and الحسنى as the consummation in which that trajectory arrives without deficiency.

strongest_changes: Universal ownership became jurisdiction over naming, shares, mediation, and moral classification, displacing conjectural human systems.
The bad/good contrast became a graded developmental field shaped by minor proximity, wide covering mercy, remembered formation, protective practice, and the ban on self-certification.
Recompense became a non-transferable pipeline from directed effort through disclosure to full settlement, while dependent accompaniment remained a coexisting possibility.
Debt, wage, harvest, created-polarity, and embodied-submission models remained live beside the strong juridical reading instead of being collapsed into it.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's split mappings and repeated roots opened materially different mechanisms: ج ز ي supported both requital and harvest, س م و supported both cosmic covering and readable marking, and doubled حسن supported beauty, beneficence, surplus, and consummation. Later context strengthened several of these rather than selecting a single winner.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether الحسنى encodes surplus beyond equivalence or simply names the best fitting outcome.
How far the non-dominant harvest and visible-mark mappings can shape prose before resonance becomes punning.
Whether permitted intercession changes settlement relationally or only confirms divine exclusivity without altering any outcome.
Whether the creation-polarity chain makes recompense ontological as well as juridical, or merely surrounds an otherwise legal account.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Comprehensive ownership enables matching recompense.** س م و B004 supplies the overhead heavens; ء ر ض B001 the lower ground; ج ز ي B001 recompense matching an act; ع م ل B001 intentional work. The vertical totality precedes the purpose clause. I infer that universal jurisdiction makes complete requital possible; the ayah reads as governance converting deeds into outcomes.
2. **Bad and good action produce non-symmetrical returns.** س و ء B001 supplies ugly badness; ح س ن B002 beneficent or skillful good action; its paired ح س ن B001 makes *al-ḥusnā* goodness/beauty. The bad are repaid “by what they did,” while good-doers receive “the best.” I infer an asymmetry between matched liability and excellent reward; the ayah does not flatten both into mechanical equivalence.
3. **Recompense also settles what is due.** ج ز ي B002 supplies sufficing, standing in, or discharging an obligation. The later “fullest recompense” (53:41) activates settlement language. I infer that judgment closes outstanding moral accounts; the ayah reads as completion of claims as well as response to acts.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:41 repeats ج ز ي B001 twice and adds و ف ي B001 fullness. The later formulation confirms the asymmetry here while making completeness explicit: recompense is not approximate or interrupted.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Universal possession enables act-matched accounting.** `ء ل ه B001` supplies the worshipped one, `س م و B004` the overhead sky, and `ء ر ض B001` lower ground, together bracketing the field. Repeated `ج ز ي B001` supplies recompense matching an act; `ع م ل B001` supplies intentional doing; `س و ء B001` badness; and `ح س ن B002` beneficent or skillful good action. The packet supplies total field, intentional acts, and symmetrical recompense; I infer the arrow comprehensive ownership and knowledge -> capacity to match return to action. The ayah reads as an accountability mechanism that replaces the earlier economy of wish and label.

2. **The repeated recompense verb keeps the two outcomes under one rule.** The same `يجزي` governs both clauses, while the bad act is tied to `بما عملوا` and the good act intensifies into `الحسنى`. The packet supplies parallel syntax and `ح س ن B001`, goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness; I infer the arrow one evaluative process -> differentiated results. The fixed balance resists treating either outcome as arbitrary.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:32 supplied the needed correction to a rigid ledger reading: matching recompense operates beside spacious, protective forgiveness and unequal developmental access.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Labels become false claims when inherited naming is used to authorize an unequal distribution without evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Naming and apportionment are one operation: a category label silently predetermines who receives the deficient share.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inherited labels fabricate stable categories
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Names received from ancestors are repeated until they appear to designate real, gendered kinds despite lacking authorization.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: naming `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; reputation sustained by a name `quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`; father or ancestor `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; spoken name `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`; male category `quranic:root_000516:B001/m01`; female category `quranic:root_000058:B001/m01`; fabricated utterance `quranic:root_001450:B013/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The labels gain social durability from ancestry and repetition, but the channel exposes that durability as manufactured speech rather than ontological proof.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Representation is effective only when entry, joining, and acceptance are authorized by the controlling authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Intercession is decomposed into gatekeeping, joinder, approval, and substitution rather than treated as a single magical act.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Joining a case does not erase individual liability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One party may stand in for or join another, but the account still distinguishes ownership, debt, deed, and due recompense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: standing in for another `quranic:root_000244:B002/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; joining as advocate `quranic:root_000802:B002/m01`; owned right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; protected obligation `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`; legal deed `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; wage for work `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Representation can alter who speaks or stands in the proceeding, but it cannot dissolve the ledger categories by which liability is assigned.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct becomes an assessable entry that is classified and repaid according to its moral quality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The moral contrast is structured as a work-and-ledger process linking deed, wage, debt, right, and settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Work is classified by its produced effect
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Intentional work produces either harmful or beneficent effects and is entered under the corresponding moral class.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; dealings or practice `quranic:root_001046:B005/m01`; bad or ugly act `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; harm produced `quranic:root_000755:B002/m01`; good quality `quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`; beneficent act `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 53:31 (ع م ل, س و ء, ح س ن).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Good and bad are not free-floating labels; they describe what intentional conduct becomes and what effects it places into the account.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct becomes an assessable entry that is classified and repaid according to its moral quality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The moral contrast is structured as a work-and-ledger process linking deed, wage, debt, right, and settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The ledger converts deeds into due settlement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A deed establishes a claim, wage, debt, or protected obligation that is discharged by equivalent recompense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: legal deed `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; wage `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`; entitlement `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; protected obligation `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; debt settlement `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; financial due `quranic:root_000244:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recompense is activated as account settlement: the quality of work generates a due that must be discharged rather than arbitrarily assigned.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Emergence begins inside a concealed enclosure and proceeds through nurture before becoming externally knowable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human origin in earth and womb is joined by one latent process of enclosure, germination, and emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Soil receives what later rises as living growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fertile ground receives moisture and a concealed beginning, then supports rooted growth and emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile soil `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; earth or ground `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; rising or emerging `quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`; creation or emergence `quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`; earth revived by rain `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; plant growth `quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`; abundant water `quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The earth-origin statement is activated as germination: what is hidden below becomes a living form through water, rooted support, and staged emergence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life-supporting water moves from an upper source into lower holding places where it enables settlement and continuity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Sky, road, knowledge, rule, and life roots jointly disclose a compact hydrological process beneath the theological argument.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain travels between sky and earth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A rain-bearing cloud releases water through the intervening space, and dry earth receives it as reviving moisture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rain-bearing cloud `quranic:root_000745:B004/m02`; rain between cloud and earth `quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`; earth revived by rain `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; cloud `quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`; abundant water `quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`; downward letting `quranic:root_000672:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The upper and lower domains are connected by a downward water route, turning the ownership of sky and earth into an ecology of dependence.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkması veya bir kişinin toplumsal değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesidir. Bakışın yukarı kaldırılması bu hareketin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
Bir kişinin değeri, saygınlığı ya da toplumdaki yeri yükselir.
Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselmeyi dalın ortak çekirdeği sayar; bunu fiziksel yükselişe, bakışın kaldırılmasına ve değerli kişinin toplumdaki yerinin yükselmesine uygular.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte olma ve örtme çekirdeği önde tutulur; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımları genel yükselme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: üstteki gök veya örtü ve buna bağlı üstten gelen ya da üstte bulunan şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: Gök ve tavan çekirdeğinin yanı sıra bulut, yağmur, bitki ve bir şeyin üst yanı için belirtilen bağlı kullanımları kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Üstte bulunma ve örtme çekirdeğiyle ona bağlı uzantıları korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan, yükselen ve onu örten üst alan veya yapı kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üstte bulunma ve örtme çekirdeğini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gökteki bulut ya da yukarıdan gelen yağmur için aktarmalı kullanım gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve ondan geldiği düşünülen yağmur uzantılarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmurun ürünü veya yerden yükselen bitki için kullanılan özel aktarımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin yağmurla veya yükselmesiyle kurulan bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Atın sırtı dahil bir nesnenin en üst yüzeyi ya da yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: At sırtını ve genel üst yüzey anlamını korur.

yağmurla çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitki

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

concept_gloss.text: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad çekirdeğini, ad verme ve edinme işlemlerini, adaşlığı ve adı hak eden denkliği birlikte kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel gitmeyi değil, av amacıyla açık ve ıssız araziye çıkmayı ve yalnız buna bağlı kişi, arama ve araç kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar av için kır ve çöl arazisine çıkmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; avcı adını, av hayvanını aramayı ve sıcak zeminde bekleyen avcının koruyucu çorabını buna bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.
